claim_summary: Exact dedicated-slot profile readback: `lssyscfg -r prof -m SYSTEM -F lpar_name,name,io_slots --header` returns comma-separated drc_index/pool_id/is_required triples in one double-quoted field, with `none` observed in the pool position of every captured triple. The unknown-attribute probe is the negative control: the HMC rejects an unrecognised -F attribute by name and exits 1, so acceptance of `io_slots` is positive evidence rather than a silent no-op. Limits, admitted by ADR 0165 and not settled by this capture: both captured profiles sit on the VIOS partition, so non-VIOS dedicated-slot assignment is unexercised; byte-stability across an add/remove on a profile that already holds slots is unexercised; and the read rendering has not been shown to be valid `chsyscfg` input. Only the captured command is admitted - not the single-field `-F io_slots`, not a headerless read, and not a --filter-narrowed read.
